**Allowed origins** are set in the `origin` callback of the `cors({...})` middleware in `worker/src/index.ts:19-35`. A browser origin is accepted if it is:

- exactly `http://localhost:4200`
- any origin ending in `.pages.dev`
- any origin ending in `.workers.dev`

Anything else, including requests with no `Origin` header, gets `null`, so no CORS headers are sent. The allowed methods are GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE and OPTIONS. The allowed headers are `Content-Type` and `Authorization`. The preflight `maxAge` is 86400.

**To add a custom domain**, edit the `if` condition at `worker/src/index.ts:23-27`. Add another clause, for example `|| origin === 'https://app.example.com'`, and redeploy the worker.

- **Exact match for a custom domain:** use `===` with the full origin, including the scheme. Don't use `endsWith` on a bare domain. `endsWith('example.com')` would also match `evilexample.com`.
- **Why not an array:** Hono matches array entries as exact strings, so wildcards don't work there. That is why the code uses a function. The comment at line 20 and `worker/src/index.md:24-25` both say this.
- **More background:** `worker/src/index.md` points to DEPLOYMENT_NOTES §4 (`docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md`). I didn't open that file. Update `worker/src/index.md:7`, which lists the allowed origins, so it stays accurate.
